+ */

+  const ver = String(version ?? '').trim()
+  if (!ver) {
+    return Promise.reject(new Error('version 不能为空'))
+  }
+  const normalizedTimeType = String(timeType || '')
+    .trim()
+    .toUpperCase()

+  }

+import { buildPsiSellOutBoardQuery } from './psiIndicatorQuery.js'

+
+function normalizeInventoryAgeSegment(raw) {
+  const healthyRate = Number(raw?.healthyRate)
+  const sluggishRate = Number(raw?.sluggishRate)
+  const hasHealthy = Number.isFinite(healthyRate)
+  const hasSluggish = Number.isFinite(sluggishRate)
+
+  const displayHealthyRate = hasHealthy ? healthyRate : 0
+  const displaySluggishRate = hasSluggish ? sluggishRate : 0
+
+  // 环图扇区：负值健康占比按 0 计，再按非负部分归一化到 100%
+  const healthySlice = Math.max(0, displayHealthyRate)
+  const sluggishSlice = Math.max(0, displaySluggishRate)
+  const sliceTotal = healthySlice + sluggishSlice
+  let chartHealthyRate = 0
+  let chartSluggishRate = 0
+  if (sliceTotal > 0) {
+    chartHealthyRate = (healthySlice / sliceTotal) * 100
+    chartSluggishRate = (sluggishSlice / sliceTotal) * 100
+  }
+
+  return {
+    totalAmount: Number(raw?.totalAmount) || 0,
+    sluggishAmount: Number(raw?.sluggishAmount) || 0,
+    healthyAmount: Number(raw?.healthyAmount) || 0,
+    healthyRate: displayHealthyRate,
+    sluggishRate: displaySluggishRate,
+    chartHealthyRate,
+    chartSluggishRate
+  }
+}
+
+export function createEmptyInventoryAgeData() {
+  const empty = normalizeInventoryAgeSegment({})
+  return {
+    snapshotDate: null,
+    overseas: { ...empty },
+    domestic: { ...empty },
+    fullProcess: { ...empty }
+  }

+/** PSI 指标看板：默认回溯周数（最近 12 周） */
+const PSI_INDICATOR_DEFAULT_WEEK_SPAN = 12
+
+/** 以今天为终点，向前回溯 n 个自然周（含今天） */
+function pastWeekCalendarRange(weekCount = PSI_INDICATOR_DEFAULT_WEEK_SPAN) {
+  const end = new Date()
+  end.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0)
+  const start = new Date(end)
+  start.setDate(start.getDate() - (Math.max(1, weekCount | 0) * 7 - 1))

+
+/** PSI 指标看板默认周范围 `[YYYYMMDD, YYYYMMDD]` */
+export function buildDefaultPsiIndicatorWeekFilterRange() {
+  const [start, end] = pastWeekCalendarRange(PSI_INDICATOR_DEFAULT_WEEK_SPAN)
+  return [dateToYmdCompact(start), dateToYmdCompact(end)]
+}
+
+/** PSI 指标看板：默认回溯月数（近一年） */
+const PSI_INDICATOR_DEFAULT_MONTH_SPAN = 12

+/** PSI 指标看板默认月范围 `[YYYY-MM, YYYY-MM]`（含当月，向前 12 个月） */
+export function buildDefaultPsiIndicatorMonthRange() {
+  const end = new Date()
+  const start = new Date(end.getFullYear(), end.getMonth() - (PSI_INDICATOR_DEFAULT_MONTH_SPAN - 1), 1)
+  const fmt = (d) => `${d.getFullYear()}-${String(d.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0')}`
+  return [fmt(start), fmt(end)]
+}
+
+/** PSI 指标看板周范围：空值回退默认最近 12 周，仅保证起止顺序 */

+import { ref } from 'vue'
+import { ElMessage } from 'element-plus'
+import { postPsiInventoryAge } from '@/api/board/psiIndicatorPanel.js'
+import { createEmptyInventoryAgeData, mapPsiInventoryAgeResponse } from './psiIndicatorMappers.js'
+import { buildPsiSellOutBoardQuery } from './psiIndicatorQuery.js'
+
+/**
+ * 库存库龄三饼图数据
+ * @param {{ onLoaded?: () => void }} [options]
+ */
+export function usePsiInventoryAge(options = {}) {
+  const { onLoaded } = options
+  const inventoryAgeData = ref(createEmptyInventoryAgeData())
+  const ageLoading = ref(false)
+  let lastRequestCtx = null
+  let requestSeq = 0
+
+  async function loadInventoryAge(ctx) {
+    if (ctx) lastRequestCtx = ctx
+    if (!lastRequestCtx) return
+
+    const seq = ++requestSeq
+    ageLoading.value = true
+    try {
+      const body = buildPsiSellOutBoardQuery(lastRequestCtx)
+      const res = await postPsiInventoryAge(body)
+      if (seq !== requestSeq) return
+
+      const payload = res?.data
+      if (payload?.code !== 0) {
+        throw new Error(payload?.msg || payload?.message || '库存库龄加载失败')
+      }
+
+      inventoryAgeData.value = mapPsiInventoryAgeResponse(payload?.data)
+      onLoaded?.()
+    } catch (e) {
+      if (seq !== requestSeq) return
+      console.error(e)
+      inventoryAgeData.value = createEmptyInventoryAgeData()
+      ElMessage.error(e?.message || '库存库龄加载失败')
+    } finally {
+      if (seq === requestSeq) ageLoading.value = false
+    }
+  }
+
+  return {
+    inventoryAgeData,
+    ageLoading,
+    loadInventoryAge
+  }
+}

+import { ref, watch } from 'vue'
+import { ElMessage } from 'element-plus'
+import { postPsiKpiOverview } from '@/api/board/psiIndicatorPanel.js'
+import { buildPsiSellOutBoardQuery } from './psiIndicatorQuery.js'
+import { createEmptyKpiCards, mapPsiKpiOverviewToCards } from './psiIndicatorMappers.js'
+
+/**
+ * 核心 KPI 五卡片数据
+ * @param {import('vue').Ref<string>} [forecastPrecisionRateType]
+ */
+export function usePsiKpiOverview(forecastPrecisionRateType) {
+  const kpiCards = ref(createEmptyKpiCards())
+  const kpiLoading = ref(false)
+  let lastFilterContext = null
+  let lastOverviewData = null
+  let requestSeq = 0
+
+  function applyOverviewData(data) {
+    lastOverviewData = data
+    kpiCards.value = mapPsiKpiOverviewToCards(data, {
+      precisionRateType: forecastPrecisionRateType?.value
+    })
+  }
+
+  async function loadKpiOverview(ctx) {
+    if (ctx) lastFilterContext = ctx
+    const filterCtx = lastFilterContext
+    if (!filterCtx) return
+
+    const seq = ++requestSeq
+    kpiLoading.value = true
+    try {
+      const body = buildPsiSellOutBoardQuery({
+        ...filterCtx,
+        channelScope: filterCtx.channelScope || 'all'
+      })
+      const res = await postPsiKpiOverview(body)
+      if (seq !== requestSeq) return
+
+      const payload = res?.data
+      if (payload?.code !== 0) {
+        throw new Error(payload?.msg || payload?.message || '核心 KPI 加载失败')
+      }
+
+      applyOverviewData(payload?.data)
+    } catch (e) {
+      if (seq !== requestSeq) return
+      console.error(e)
+      lastOverviewData = null
+      kpiCards.value = createEmptyKpiCards()
+      ElMessage.error(e?.message || '核心 KPI 加载失败')
+    } finally {
+      if (seq === requestSeq) kpiLoading.value = false
+    }
+  }
+
+  if (forecastPrecisionRateType) {
+    watch(forecastPrecisionRateType, () => {
+      if (lastOverviewData != null) {
+        applyOverviewData(lastOverviewData)
+      }
+    })
+  }
+
+  return {
+    kpiCards,
+    kpiLoading,
+    loadKpiOverview
+  }
+}
